source: github-atlas (GitHub search by stars, pulled 2026-11-11; each repo described from its README)

repos.what: Curated step-by-step guides for rebuilding technologies (git, Docker, databases, renderers, bots) from scratch.
repos.use_when: User wants to deeply understand how a technology works by implementing a minimal version of it.
repos.lesson: Learning by re-implementation: a minimal clone teaches internals faster than docs.

repos.what: The root index of all 'awesome' curated lists on every topic.
repos.use_when: Need a starting point to discover the curated awesome-list for a niche topic.
repos.lesson: Strict list-inclusion criteria and a linter (awesome-lint) keep curated lists high quality.

repos.what: A categorized list of free public APIs with auth/HTTPS/CORS flags.
repos.use_when: Need a free API for some data source (weather, finance, media, translation) for an app or script.
repos.lesson: Tabulate each entry with Auth/HTTPS/CORS columns so consumers can filter fast.

repos.what: freeCodeCamp's open-source learning platform and full curriculum (web, Python, math, CS).
repos.use_when: User wants a free structured course or exercises to learn coding.

repos.what: REA: an agent reverse-engineering toolkit (MCP + CLI) for native binaries, managed code, Electron/JS, APK, firmware and live runtimes.
repos.use_when: User asks what a binary/app/APK/site does internally, wants decompilation, or to compare versions of a shipped artifact.
repos.lesson: Evidence-first tool results: every finding carries provenance and an untrusted-content flag.

repos.what: A huge multilingual list of free programming books, courses and podcasts.
repos.use_when: User wants a free book or course on a programming topic, including non-English (Arabic) ones.

repos.what: OpenClaw: a self-hosted personal AI assistant gateway that connects models to chat apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord...) and device apps.
repos.use_when: User wants an always-on personal agent reachable from messaging apps with local state.
repos.lesson: Keep state, memory and credentials on the user's hardware; configuration is the only difference between personal and shared deployments.

repos.what: A system-design study guide with diagrams, trade-offs and interview Anki cards.
repos.use_when: Designing a scalable backend or preparing for a system-design interview.
repos.lesson: Explain each design choice as a trade-off, not a rule.

repos.what: roadmap.sh: interactive role and skill roadmaps (frontend, backend, AI engineer, devops...).
repos.use_when: User asks what to learn next or the order of topics for a tech career path.

repos.what: A multi-month computer-science study plan for software engineering interviews.
repos.use_when: User wants a structured self-study CS checklist.

repos.what: Catalog of free software network services and web apps you can self-host, by category.
repos.use_when: User wants a self-hosted alternative to a SaaS (media server, file sync, analytics, wiki...).
repos.lesson: Each entry lists license and language so readers can filter by constraints.

repos.what: Opinionated list of the best Python frameworks, libraries and tools by task.
repos.use_when: Need to pick a Python library for a task (video, audio, scraping, GUI, CLI...).

repos.what: Matt Pocock's small composable agent skills for real engineering (TDD, planning, refactoring).
repos.use_when: Want lightweight, adaptable engineering skills for Claude Code instead of a heavy process framework.
repos.lesson: Keep skills small and composable so the human keeps control and bugs stay debuggable.

repos.what: Superpowers: a full agentic dev methodology as composable skills (brainstorm, plan, TDD, subagent-driven development).
repos.use_when: Want Claude Code to follow a disciplined plan-then-execute workflow with subagents and tests.
repos.lesson: Bootstrap instructions that force the agent to check for a relevant skill before acting.

repos.what: ECC: agent-harness optimization pack of skills, instincts, memory, hooks and security scanning for Claude Code and others.
repos.use_when: Want a ready bundle of Claude Code skills/hooks/memory practices plus an agent config security scan.
repos.install_windows: /plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC  then  /plugin install ecc@ecc   (or: npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup)
repos.lesson: Publish an explicit list of official install channels to fight typosquatting.

repos.what: Curated project-based tutorials grouped by programming language.
repos.use_when: User wants to learn a language by building a concrete project.

repos.what: DeepSeek Harness (dsh): DeepSeek's plugin-based open-source agent harness with web UI (developer preview).
repos.use_when: Want to try an alternative coding/agent harness built around DeepSeek models.
repos.lesson: Everything-is-a-plugin architecture keeps the core tiny and features swappable.

repos.what: 996.ICU: activism repo against the 996 overtime work schedule, with an anti-996 license.
repos.use_when: Rarely; only for context on the anti-996 license or labor movement.

repos.what: Hermes Agent by Nous Research: a self-improving agent that writes and refines its own skills, with memory, subagents and messaging gateways.
repos.use_when: Want a persistent agent with a learning loop that creates skills from experience and runs on a VPS or desktop.
repos.lesson: A learning loop: turn successful episodes into skills and nudge the agent to persist knowledge.

repos.what: Collection of sysadmin/security/network cheatsheets, one-liners and CLI/web tools.
repos.use_when: Need a quick CLI one-liner, network/security tool or cheatsheet.

repos.what: The Linux kernel source tree.
repos.use_when: Only when reading kernel internals or building a custom kernel.

repos.what: React: the JavaScript library for building component-based user interfaces.
repos.use_when: Building an interactive web UI or the frontend of a web/desktop app.

repos.what: A single CLAUDE.md distilled from Andrej Karpathy's notes on LLM coding pitfalls (think first, simplicity, surgical changes, goal-driven).
repos.use_when: Want to reduce over-engineering and wrong assumptions in Claude Code with a short behavior file.
repos.lesson: State assumptions explicitly, prefer the simplest diff, and define verifiable success criteria before coding.

repos.what: Educational implementations of algorithms in Python.
repos.use_when: Need a readable reference implementation of a classic algorithm.

repos.what: opencode: an open-source terminal AI coding agent supporting many model providers.
repos.use_when: Need a provider-agnostic open-source coding agent in the terminal.

repos.what: Vue 2 repository (end of life; Vue 3 lives in vuejs/core).
repos.use_when: Only to maintain a legacy Vue 2 app; new work should use vuejs/core.
repos.lesson: Put an EOL banner and successor link at the very top of a dead repo's README.

repos.what: OSSU: a complete free computer-science degree curriculum from online courses.
repos.use_when: User wants a full self-taught CS curriculum.

repos.what: n8n: fair-code visual workflow automation platform with AI agents, code nodes and 1500+ integrations.
repos.use_when: User wants to automate multi-app workflows (social posting, webhooks, AI pipelines) visually and self-hosted.

repos.what: DigitalPlat FreeDomain: free domain registration service plus DNS learning guides.
repos.use_when: User needs a free domain name for a test site and custom nameservers.

repos.what: yt-dlp: command-line audio/video downloader for thousands of sites with format selection, subtitles and post-processing.
repos.use_when: Download any online video/audio (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X...) at best quality, or extract audio/subtitles.
repos.lesson: Output templates and format-selection expressions give users a tiny DSL instead of dozens of flags.

repos.what: TensorFlow: Google's end-to-end machine learning framework.
repos.use_when: Training or running ML models where the TF ecosystem (Keras, TFLite) is required.

repos.what: Firecrawl: API and self-hostable service to search, scrape and crawl websites into LLM-ready markdown/JSON.
repos.use_when: Need clean content from web pages (including JS-heavy) or a whole site crawl for an agent.
repos.install_windows: pip install firecrawl   (Node: npm install firecrawl; CLI/skill: npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest init --all --browser)

repos.what: Microsoft Activation Scripts: open-source Windows/Office activator (HWID, Ohook, TSforge, KMS).
repos.use_when: Avoid recommending; licensing circumvention of Microsoft products.
repos.lesson: Risky: bypasses Microsoft licensing; never run piped remote scripts on the owner's machine.

repos.what: JavaScript implementations of algorithms and data structures with explanations.
repos.use_when: Need a JS reference implementation of an algorithm.

repos.what: Visual Studio Code (Code - OSS) source repository.
repos.use_when: User needs a code editor or wants to build/extend VS Code.

repos.what: MarkItDown: Python tool converting PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, audio, HTML and more into Markdown for LLMs.
repos.use_when: Need to turn office documents/PDFs into Markdown text Claude can read or index.
repos.lesson: Call the narrowest converter for the job and treat converted input as untrusted I/O.

repos.what: Claw Code: an agent-maintained Rust coding-harness 'museum exhibit', explicitly not a production project.
repos.use_when: Rarely; curiosity about agent-maintained repos.

repos.what: Curated list of Go frameworks, libraries and software.
repos.use_when: Need to pick a Go library for a task.

repos.what: Anthropic's official Agent Skills repository (document skills docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx and examples).
repos.use_when: Need an official reference skill or document-handling skills for Claude.
repos.lesson: Skill = folder with SKILL.md frontmatter (name+description) plus scripts; description drives triggering.

repos.what: Oh My Zsh: community framework of zsh plugins and themes.
repos.use_when: Customizing a zsh shell on Linux/macOS/WSL.

repos.what: Ponytail: a coding-agent skill that pushes minimal code ('laziest senior dev') while keeping tests on risky logic.
repos.use_when: Want the agent to write less code and fewer tokens without dropping tests.
repos.lesson: Benchmark a skill against the same agent without it, over several runs, and publish the numbers.

repos.what: HelloGitHub: monthly Chinese digest of interesting beginner-friendly open-source projects.
repos.use_when: Discovering interesting new open-source projects by category.

repos.what: AutoGPT: platform of AI 'experts' and agents for content, sales and research work, cloud or self-hosted.
repos.use_when: Want a hosted/self-hosted autonomous agent platform for recurring business tasks.

repos.what: Chinese 100-day Python course from beginner to advanced.
repos.use_when: Learning Python (Chinese-language material).

repos.what: Ollama: run open LLMs (Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, gpt-oss...) locally with a simple CLI and REST API.
repos.use_when: Need a local/offline LLM or embeddings on the user's PC.
repos.install_windows: irm https://ollama.com/install.ps1 | iex   (safer: winget install Ollama.Ollama, or download https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe)

repos.what: Chinese CS interview notes (OS, networking, DB, Java, LLM apps).
repos.use_when: Studying CS fundamentals (Chinese).

repos.what: You Don't Know JS Yet: book series on JavaScript core mechanisms.
repos.use_when: Deeply understanding JavaScript semantics.

repos.what: Flutter: Google's SDK for building mobile, web and desktop apps from one Dart codebase.
repos.use_when: Building a cross-platform mobile/desktop app with a single codebase.

repos.what: prompts.chat: the largest open-source library of AI prompts (formerly Awesome ChatGPT Prompts).
repos.use_when: Need a ready role/prompt template for ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

repos.what: GitHub's official collection of .gitignore templates.
repos.use_when: Creating a .gitignore for a new project.

repos.what: Bootstrap: popular responsive HTML/CSS/JS front-end framework.
repos.use_when: Quickly styling a responsive web page or admin UI.

repos.what: Hugging Face Transformers: model definitions and pipelines for text, vision, audio and multimodal models.
repos.use_when: Running or fine-tuning a pretrained model (ASR, translation, captioning, classification) in Python.

repos.what: The Agency: a large roster of specialized AI agent personas (frontend, marketing, Reddit, QA) for Claude Code and others.
repos.use_when: Want ready subagent definitions for roles like designer, marketer or reviewer.
repos.lesson: Give each agent a personality, process and concrete deliverables, not just a title.

repos.what: AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI: Gradio interface for txt2img, img2img, inpainting, outpainting and upscaling.
repos.use_when: Generating or editing images locally with Stable Diffusion via a web UI.

repos.what: The Art of Command Line: one-page guide to fluent shell usage.
repos.use_when: Learning practical command-line habits and tools.

repos.what: Dify: open-source LLM app platform with visual workflows, RAG pipelines, agents and model management.
repos.use_when: Building a hosted chatbot/RAG/agent app with a GUI and API without much code.

repos.what: JavaGuide: Chinese Java and backend interview guide.
repos.use_when: Studying Java/backend interview topics (Chinese).

repos.what: Open WebUI: self-hosted offline ChatGPT-style interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible models.
repos.use_when: Want a local web chat UI over local or API models with RAG and tools.

repos.what: Clash Verge Rev: Tauri GUI client for the Clash Meta (mihomo) proxy core.
repos.use_when: User needs a rule-based proxy client on Windows (e.g., to bypass geo-blocks for downloads).

repos.what: Langflow: visual builder for AI agents and workflows that exposes each flow as an API and MCP server.
repos.use_when: Prototype an agent/RAG flow visually and expose it as an API or MCP tool.

repos.what: Claude Code: Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal, IDE and GitHub.
repos.use_when: The agent itself; consult for plugins, issues, changelog and official install.

repos.what: scrcpy: mirror and control Android devices (video+audio) over USB/TCP, with recording, no root.
repos.use_when: Need to mirror, record or control an Android phone screen from the PC.
repos.lesson: Only the official repo is a trusted source: warn users against lookalike downloads.

repos.what: CC Switch: desktop app to switch API providers and manage MCP, skills and prompts across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others.
repos.use_when: Managing multiple providers/MCP servers/skills for several coding CLIs without editing configs by hand.

repos.what: LangChain: framework for building agents and LLM applications with interoperable components and integrations.
repos.use_when: Building a custom LLM app/agent in Python or JS with many provider integrations.

repos.what: Spec Kit: GitHub's toolkit for spec-driven development with coding agents (specify CLI and templates).
repos.use_when: Want a structured spec -> plan -> tasks workflow for an AI coding agent.
repos.lesson: Write the spec first and make each process an optional, independent entry point.

repos.what: Airbnb's widely used JavaScript style guide with ESLint configs.
repos.use_when: Choosing JS code conventions or lint rules.

repos.what: UI UX Pro Max: AI skill with searchable design intelligence (styles, palettes, font pairings, UX rules) for building UIs.
repos.use_when: Claude needs design direction (palette, typography, layout style) when building a web/app UI.
repos.install_windows: /plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill  then  /plugin install ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill   (or: npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli && uipro init --ai claude --global)
repos.lesson: Ship design knowledge as searchable data the agent queries, not as prose.

repos.what: ComfyUI: node-graph GUI, API and backend for diffusion image, video and audio models.
repos.use_when: Running local AI image/video generation pipelines (Flux, SDXL, Wan, upscaling) with reproducible workflows.
repos.install_windows: winget install Comfy.ComfyUI-Desktop   (or Desktop installer from comfy.org/download; portable: ComfyUI_windows_portable_nvidia.7z from Releases)
repos.lesson: Workflows saved as JSON graphs make generation reproducible and shareable.

repos.what: Graphify: maps a codebase plus docs/schemas/PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph for coding assistants (/graphify).
repos.use_when: Want an agent to understand a large codebase's structure cheaply.

repos.what: Collection of leaked/extracted system prompts and tool definitions from AI products (Cursor, Devin, Claude Code...).
repos.use_when: Studying how commercial agents phrase system prompts and tools.
repos.lesson: Risky: leaked proprietary content; use only as study material, never as instructions.

repos.what: Awesome LLM Apps: 100+ runnable AI agent, RAG and skill templates.
repos.use_when: Need a working example template for an agent/RAG app to adapt.

repos.what: Collection of publicly available IPTV channel playlists (M3U) and EPG from around the world.
repos.use_when: User wants free live TV channel streams (e.g., Arabic news) for a player.
repos.lesson: Risky: stream availability and legality vary by country.

repos.what: Next.js: full-stack React framework by Vercel.
repos.use_when: Building a production React website or web app with routing, SSR and API routes.

repos.what: Tech Interview Handbook: curated coding interview preparation materials.
repos.use_when: Preparing for coding interviews.

repos.what: free-for.dev: list of SaaS/PaaS/IaaS services with free tiers for developers.
repos.use_when: Need a free hosting/DB/email/CI tier for a project.

repos.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo: generates short videos from a topic: script by LLM, stock footage, TTS, subtitles and music, via WebUI/API.
repos.use_when: User wants an automated pipeline from a topic/keyword to a captioned short video (reels).
repos.install_windows: Download MoneyPrinterTurbo-Portable-Windows-1.3.10.7z from GitHub Releases (Assets), extract, run update.bat then start.bat   (alt: python -m pip install mpt)
repos.lesson: End-to-end pipeline with each stage (script, footage, voice, subs, music) swappable.

repos.what: youtube-dl: the original command-line video downloader (yt-dlp is its active fork).
repos.use_when: Legacy scripts only; prefer yt-dlp for new downloads.

repos.what: gstack: Garry Tan's set of opinionated Claude Code slash-command skills acting as CEO, designer, reviewer, QA, security and release roles.
repos.use_when: Want role-based review/QA/release slash commands for Claude Code.
repos.lesson: Model the agent as a team of specialist roles each with its own checklist.

repos.what: Microsoft PowerToys: 30+ Windows utilities (FancyZones, PowerRename, Color Picker, Text Extractor, Image Resizer...).
repos.use_when: Windows productivity tasks like batch rename, image resize, OCR from screen or color picking.

repos.what: The Go programming language source.
repos.use_when: Installing Go or reading Go internals.

repos.what: labuladong's algorithm notes teaching LeetCode problem-solving frameworks.
repos.use_when: Learning algorithm thinking patterns.

repos.what: Excalidraw: open-source hand-drawn style collaborative whiteboard and embeddable React component.
repos.use_when: Quick diagrams, wireframes or storyboards in a sketch style, or embedding a whiteboard in an app.

repos.what: Codex CLI: OpenAI's local terminal coding agent.
repos.use_when: Need OpenAI's coding agent or a second-opinion agent alongside Claude Code.

repos.what: llama.cpp: C/C++ LLM inference engine for GGUF models with CLI and OpenAI-compatible server.
repos.use_when: Run quantized LLMs locally with maximum control/performance (CPU/GPU).

repos.what: Hello Algo: animated, runnable data structures and algorithms book.
repos.use_when: Learning DSA with visuals.

repos.what: 30 seconds of code: short coding articles and snippets (JS, CSS, Python, Git).
repos.use_when: Need a quick idiomatic snippet for a common task.

repos.what: Kubernetes: container orchestration system.
repos.use_when: Deploying/scaling containerized services on clusters.

repos.what: RustDesk: open-source self-hostable remote desktop (AnyDesk/TeamViewer alternative).
repos.use_when: Need remote control of another PC, optionally with your own relay server.

repos.what: shadcn/ui: copy-into-your-project accessible React components with a CLI.
repos.use_when: Building a polished React/Next.js UI quickly with owned component code.
repos.lesson: Distribute components as source the user owns, not as an opaque dependency.

repos.what: React Native: build native mobile apps with React.
repos.use_when: Building iOS/Android apps with React skills.

repos.what: Awesome DESIGN.md: DESIGN.md files capturing popular brands' design systems for AI UI generation.
repos.use_when: Want Claude to build a UI matching a known brand's visual language.
repos.lesson: Hand the agent a design-token file (DESIGN.md) to keep generated UI visually consistent.

repos.what: Index of awesome lists for hacking, pentesting, reverse engineering and security research.
repos.use_when: Finding security/RE tools and resources by area.

repos.what: Electron: build cross-platform desktop apps with JavaScript, HTML and CSS on Chromium+Node.
repos.use_when: Packaging a web app as a Windows desktop app.

repos.what: Node.js: the cross-platform JavaScript runtime.
repos.use_when: Running JS tools/CLIs or servers.

repos.what: Microsoft's 21-lesson course on building generative AI applications (translated to Arabic too).
repos.use_when: Learning gen-AI app building fundamentals (prompting, RAG, agents).

repos.what: TradingAgents: multi-agent LLM framework simulating a trading firm (analysts, researchers, trader, risk).
repos.use_when: Research on multi-agent financial analysis; not for real trading advice.
repos.lesson: Debate between opposing agent roles (bull/bear) before a decision.

repos.what: Rust compiler, standard library and docs.
repos.use_when: Installing Rust or building Rust tools.

repos.what: Orca: desktop orchestrator that runs fleets of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) in parallel worktrees with diffs and browser.
repos.use_when: Run several coding agents in parallel on one project with isolated worktrees.

repos.what: Pi: minimal extensible agent harness and coding-agent CLI with unified LLM API, extensions and skills.
repos.use_when: Want a small hackable coding agent/SDK to customize.
repos.lesson: Pin dependencies in the installer; use --ignore-scripts when installing from npm.

repos.what: browser-use: open-source Python browser agent where the LLM writes code in a REPL driving Chrome via CDP.
repos.use_when: Automate a real browser task (forms, logins, scraping dynamic pages) with an LLM.
repos.lesson: The minimal agent: model + REPL + raw protocol; fewer abstractions, more capability.

repos.what: GUI proxy client for Windows/Linux/macOS that drives Xray and sing-box cores (VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks).
repos.use_when: User needs a desktop client to route traffic through a V2Ray/Xray/sing-box proxy or bypass a geo-block.
repos.install_windows: Download the Windows zip from https://github.com/2dust/v2rayN/releases and run v2rayN.exe

repos.what: Free, open-source multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine with its own editor and GDScript/C# scripting.
repos.use_when: User wants to build a 2D/3D game or interactive app and export it to desktop, mobile or web.
repos.install_windows: winget install GodotEngine.GodotEngine ?  (or download from https://godotengine.org/download)
repos.lesson: A single self-contained editor binary with headless CLI export makes an engine scriptable by agents.

repos.what: Curated index of free Chinese-language programming books.
repos.use_when: User asks for free programming books in Chinese.

repos.what: Agent skill plus local proxy that makes coding agents answer and read in terse 'caveman' style to cut token usage.
repos.use_when: User wants to reduce token/cost usage of Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI sessions.
repos.lesson: Output style is a cost lever: instruct the agent to drop filler and state only results; publish measured savings per feature.

repos.what: Self-hosted photo and video backup and management server with mobile apps, a Google Photos alternative.
repos.use_when: User wants to self-host a private photo/video library with auto-backup from phones, face and semantic search.
repos.install_windows: docker compose up -d  (with docker-compose.yml and .env from the latest release, per https://immich.app/docs) ?

repos.what: Categorised list of quality macOS applications.
repos.use_when: User asks which macOS app to use for a task.

repos.what: JavaScript 3D library rendering with WebGL/WebGPU, plus SVG and CSS3D addons.
repos.use_when: User wants a 3D scene, product viewer, particle effect or animated 3D website in the browser.
repos.lesson: Ship a huge runnable examples gallery; the examples are the real documentation.

repos.what: Claude Code plugin that records session activity, compresses it with AI and injects relevant context into later sessions.
repos.use_when: User wants Claude Code (or other agents) to remember past sessions and decisions automatically.
repos.install_windows: /plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem  then  /plugin install claude-mem ?
repos.lesson: Capture with hooks, compress asynchronously, retrieve progressively (index first, details on demand) to keep context small.

repos.what: Collection of 25 production-grade engineering skills for coding agents (spec, TDD, code review, debugging, shipping).
repos.use_when: User wants disciplined engineering workflows (requirements interview, TDD, five-axis review) installed into an agent.
repos.install_windows: npx skills add addyosmani/agent-skills   (or /plugin marketplace add addyosmani/agent-skills)
repos.lesson: Each skill is a gated workflow with explicit verification steps, not just advice.

repos.what: Open-source Postgres development platform with auth, storage, realtime, edge functions and vector embeddings.
repos.use_when: User needs a backend (database, auth, file storage, realtime) for a web or mobile app quickly.
repos.install_windows: npx supabase init && npx supabase start  (needs Docker) ?

repos.what: JavaScript library for data-driven visualisation with SVG, Canvas and HTML.
repos.use_when: User wants a custom or unusual chart, map or animated data visualisation in the browser.

repos.what: Agent skills that give coding agents frontend design taste through art direction, reference images and a browser check.
repos.use_when: User wants non-generic, well-designed web pages from a coding agent instead of 'AI slop'.
repos.lesson: Force a visual reference and a real browser screenshot check before calling a design done.

repos.what: Open-source app to orchestrate and govern teams of AI agents as a company with org charts, budgets and heartbeats.
repos.use_when: User wants to run and supervise many agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) with goals, cost limits and task tracking.
repos.lesson: Give every agent a budget, a reporting line and a heartbeat so runaway work is visible and stoppable.

repos.what: Framework for building small, secure desktop and mobile apps with a web frontend and a Rust backend.
repos.use_when: User wants to ship a web UI as a lightweight native Windows/macOS/Linux app instead of Electron.
repos.install_windows: npm create tauri-app@latest  (needs Rust and WebView2)

repos.what: General-purpose multilingual speech recognition model and CLI for transcription and translation.
repos.use_when: User needs to transcribe or subtitle audio/video, including Arabic, into text/SRT/VTT.
repos.install_windows: pip install -U openai-whisper  (needs ffmpeg on PATH)
repos.lesson: One CLI that takes a media file and emits txt/srt/vtt/json makes a model immediately usable in pipelines.

repos.what: The TypeScript language and compiler, a typed superset of JavaScript.
repos.use_when: User needs type checking or compilation of TypeScript code.

repos.what: Community-curated collection of computer science papers organised by topic.
repos.use_when: User wants classic CS papers to read on a subject.

repos.what: CLI that lets AI agents read and search Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu and other sites without paid APIs.
repos.use_when: Agent must read or search social platforms and web pages that block ordinary fetching.
repos.lesson: A uniform 'tool <channel> <action> [args]' grammar plus a 'channels' discovery command lets an agent learn the tool by itself.

repos.what: Fast reverse proxy that exposes a local server behind NAT or a firewall to the internet.
repos.use_when: User wants to expose a local web app or service publicly through their own server.

repos.what: CLI that finds social media accounts by username across hundreds of sites.
repos.use_when: User wants to check where a username exists (OSINT) or whether a handle is free across platforms.
repos.lesson: Keep site definitions in a data file so the community extends the tool without touching code.

repos.what: Promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js.
repos.use_when: Code needs HTTP requests with interceptors, timeouts and cancellation in JS/TS.

repos.use_when: User wants to run TypeScript scripts directly with sandboxed permissions and no build step.
repos.lesson: Deny-by-default permissions (--allow-net, --allow-read) are a good model for running untrusted scripts.

repos.what: Open-source terminal AI agent powered by Gemini with MCP support.
repos.use_when: User wants a second coding/terminal agent or Gemini's large context from the command line.

repos.what: Book code that implements a GPT-like LLM in PyTorch step by step, including pretraining and fine-tuning.
repos.use_when: User wants to understand how LLMs work internally by building one.

repos.what: Weekly Chinese-language tech newsletter published every Friday.
repos.use_when: User wants Chinese tech news digests.

repos.what: Design vocabulary and command set for coding agents (polish, bolder, critique, audit) with detectors for AI-slop patterns.
